content_sections.heading: HPPSC HPAS Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India. A candidate must possess a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a recognized university. Candidates awaiting results of a qualifying examination, or those about to appear, may also apply subject to the conditions specified in the official notification. Candidates who have passed the final professional M.B.B.S. or an equivalent medical examination but have not completed internship may be provisionally admitted, subject to submitting proof at the time of the Personality Test.

content_sections.heading: HPPSC HPAS Age Limit
content_sections.text: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not have attained the age of 35 years as on 01-01-2026. Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Persons with Disabilities/Children and Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters of Himachal Pradesh, only where a post is reserved for these categories. Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen of HP for HPAS and HP Police Service posts is as per the Ex-Servicemen (Reservation of Vacancies, Pay Fixation and Regulation of Seniority in the HPAS) Rules, 2020. Government servants of HP holding substantive/officiating/contractual appointments are eligible up to 45 years for HPAS and other posts (Tehsildar, Block Development Officer, Treasury Officer), 42 years for HP Police Service, and 42 years for District Controller (Class-I Gazetted). Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: HPPSC HPAS Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: A uniform examination fee is charged from all candidates, irrespective of category: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstance. Payment can be made online via Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, or any other prescribed online digital mode. Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: HPPSC HPAS Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination (Screening): Two objective-type papers of 200 marks each - General Studies and Aptitude Test. This is a qualifying/screening stage only; marks are not counted for final merit. Main Examination: Includes compulsory papers (English, Hindi, Essay, General Studies I, II, III) and two papers of one optional subject. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks in each of the Hindi and English compulsory papers and 45% in the aggregate (excluding Hindi and English) to qualify. Personality Test (Interview): Candidates qualifying the Main Examination are called for a Personality Test to assess overall suitability. Final merit is based on marks obtained in the Main Examination (written papers, excluding Hindi and English) and the Personality Test.

content_sections.heading: HPPSC HPAS Examination Centres
content_sections.text: The Preliminary and Main Examinations will be conducted at the following stations: Bilaspur, Chamba, Hamirpur, Kangra, Dharamshala, Palampur, Kullu, Mandi, Shimla, Nahan, Solan, Una, Sundernagar, and Rampur Bushahr. Candidates holding a graduate degree can also explore more Himachal Pradesh Government Jobs and Graduate Government Jobs available across India. Aspirants preparing for administrative and civil services can also check the latest Shimla Recruitment 2026 Jobs and State Administrative Service Jobs for more opportunities matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission to fill 22 vacancies across five posts through the H.P. Administrative Service Combined Competitive Examination-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 22 vacancies are available across H.P. Administrative Services, Block Development Officer, District Controller, District Treasury Officer, and Tehsildar posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for submission of the online application and fee payment is 22/09/2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 35 years of age as on 01-01-2026, with age relaxation available for reserved categories and Ex-Servicemen as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A uniform fee of Rs. 600 is charged from all candidates, irrespective of category.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for HPPSC HPAS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official HPPSC website (hppsc.hp.gov.in) after completing One Time Registration (OTR) on the portal.
